title: Scripture and Evangelism
definition: Scripture and Evangelism means God’s Word reveals the Gospel message believers are sent to proclaim to the world.
summary: Scripture and Evangelism means God’s Word reveals the Gospel message believers are sent to proclaim to the world.
christFocus: Jesus is the crucified and risen Savior announced by Scripture, and evangelism faithfully bears witness to Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Evangelism must be shaped by Scripture because Scripture gives the message. The Gospel is not self-improvement, moral advice, religious salesmanship, or human inspiration. It is the good news of Christ’s death, resurrection, lordship, and saving grace.

Scripture also shapes the spirit of evangelism. Believers proclaim truth with humility, love, urgency, and dependence on the Holy Spirit. They do not save anyone; they bear witness to the Savior.

From Genesis to Revelation, God’s Word reveals His heart to redeem people for Himself. Evangelism is not pressure to join a movement; it is an invitation to repent, believe, and receive life in Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
When evangelism loses Scripture, it can become manipulation, entertainment, argument, or vague encouragement. Scripture keeps the message clear: sinners need Christ, and Christ is mighty to save.

This doctrine also helps believers who feel unqualified to witness. The power is not in their personality but in the Gospel God has spoken and the Spirit who gives life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Share the Gospel from Scripture with love and clarity. Tell people who Jesus is, what He has done, why they need Him, and how they may respond in repentance and faith, trusting the Holy Spirit to work through the Word.
